package service

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	genservice "PROJECT_MODULE/gen/PROJECT_PACKAGE"
	"PROJECT_MODULE/internal/helper"
	"goa.design/goa-ai/runtime/agent/model"
	"goa.design/goa-ai/runtime/agent/prompt"
)

type (
	// promptRecorder supplies a final answer and records the model request
	// made by the real generated service and helper planner.
	promptRecorder struct {
		// requests receives exactly one model request per question.
		requests chan *model.Request
	}

	// promptReply streams one final answer with no tool calls.
	promptReply struct {
		// next identifies the next chunk returned to the model client.
		next int
	}
)

// TestAskSendsTheRegisteredPrompt calls the public service method twice and
// checks the actual model requests. Each question still has its own run.
func TestAskSendsTheRegisteredPrompt(t *testing.T) {
	provider := &promptRecorder{requests: make(chan *model.Request, 1)}
	client, err := model.NewClient(provider)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	svc := New(client)
	var previousRun string
	for range 2 {
		out, err := svc.Ask(t.Context(), &genservice.AskPayload{Question: "How much is tea?"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if out.Answer != "Test answer" || out.RunID == "" || out.RunID == previousRun {
			t.Fatalf("Ask returned %+v after run %q", out, previousRun)
		}
		previousRun = out.RunID
		select {
		case request := <-provider.requests:
			want := []prompt.PromptRef{{ID: "PROJECT_NAME.helper.system", Version: "v1"}}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(request.PromptRefs, want) {
				t.Fatalf("model prompt references = %+v, want %+v", request.PromptRefs, want)
			}
			if len(request.Messages) == 0 || request.Messages[0].Role != model.ConversationRoleSystem ||
				request.Messages[0].Text() != helper.SystemPrompt().Template {
				t.Fatalf("model did not receive the registered baseline: %+v", request.Messages)
			}
		default:
			t.Fatal("Ask returned without making a model request")
		}
	}
}

// Complete is unsupported because the helper planner streams its requests.
func (p *promptRecorder) Complete(context.Context, *model.Request) (*model.Response, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("expected a streaming model request")
}

// Stream records the request before returning its final-answer stream. An
// unexpected extra model call fails rather than blocking the test.
func (p *promptRecorder) Stream(_ context.Context, request *model.Request) (model.Streamer, error) {
	select {
	case p.requests <- request:
		return &promptReply{}, nil
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("unexpected extra model request")
	}
}

// Recv emits the final text, its stop reason, then the end of the stream.
func (s *promptReply) Recv() (model.Chunk, error) {
	s.next++
	switch s.next {
	case 1:
		return model.TextChunk{Message: model.Message{
			Role: model.ConversationRoleAssistant,
			Parts: []model.Part{model.TextPart{Text: "Test answer"}},
		}}, nil
	case 2:
		return model.StopChunk{Reason: "end_turn"}, nil
	default:
		return nil, io.EOF
	}
}

// Response returns the same final answer after the stream has been read.
func (s *promptReply) Response() *model.Response {
	return &model.Response{Content: []model.Message{{
		Role: model.ConversationRoleAssistant,
		Parts: []model.Part{model.TextPart{Text: "Test answer"}},
	}}, StopReason: "end_turn"}
}

// Close releases nothing because this stream owns no external resources.
func (s *promptReply) Close() error {
	return nil
}
